datasets.execution_gate: materialize the exact hashed file and record source-specific licence terms before pilot or formal use
datasets.parsing: retain a row only when all six selected values are nonempty finite floats; no interpolation or imputation; stop at 35000 retained rows
datasets.targets: observed load for each ordered node at processed position t+24
datasets.real_edge_map: per-split undirected absolute-Pearson functional graph; threshold 0.7; minimum pairwise-finite overlap 168; training prefix only
datasets.scope: functional association, not physical transmission topology

source_artifacts: three annual solar-home half-hourly data files
datasets.execution_gate: record all raw file paths, byte sizes, SHA-256 hashes, source-specific licence terms, and processed-file hash before pilot or formal use
datasets.row_filter: GC rows only; malformed or short daily rows are rejected; rejected rows and dates must be logged
datasets.hourly_aggregation: sum adjacent half-hour cells; the inherited parser treated an empty half-hour cell as zero and that rule is frozen but must be counted
datasets.timestamp_semantics: 24 naive YYYY-MM-DDTHH:00 labels per parsed date; no timezone or daylight-saving claim
datasets.targets: leaf observed load and contemporaneous deterministic region/system sums at processed position t+24
datasets.selection_provenance: leaf IDs and postcode-sorted groups are copied from the existing manuscript; historical full-record availability and energy informed leaf selection
datasets.selection_limitation: not a train-only leaf-selection design; frozen before this new experiment but not evidence of physical feeder topology

claim_limits: provider-owned public data; no ownership claim
Ausgrid hierarchy is not feeder topology
OPSD correlation graph is not transmission topology
